description: This file contains unit tests for the ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategy class in the OrangeHRM project. It tests data purging strategies applied to Employee entities, verifying that the purge methods correctly modify entity fields according to specified formats and that the strategy retrieval functions work as expected.

classes.name: ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategyTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategy class, ensuring its methods correctly purge data and retrieve strategies.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, configures the purge strategy, and loads test data fixtures.

methods.name: testPurge
methods.description: Verifies that the purge method correctly updates Employee fields to expected 'purged' values.

methods.name: testPurgeRecord
methods.description: Checks that the purgeRecord method correctly modifies an Employee entity and persists the changes.

methods.name: testGetReplaceStrategy
methods.description: Tests that the protected method retrieves the correct type of ValueFormatter instance based on strategy name.

methods.name: invokeProtectedGetReplaceStrategy
methods.description: Helper method to invoke the protected getReplaceStrategy method of the class under test, using reflection or method invocation.
